phases.objective: Resolve Work Map changed files from an immutable base/head pair in GitHub Actions and fail closed instead of silently falling back to the last parent commit.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request or writer-dispatched Work Map Integration run on a rebuilt merge candidate
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The gate evaluates exactly base SHA...head SHA, excludes files visible only in HEAD~1 history, and rejects missing, stale, or unavailable identities before governance evaluation.
steps: Create a temporary Git history whose first parent contains unrelated Spec files while the exact base-to-head candidate changes only one bounded file.
Prove the legacy HEAD~1 comparison sees the unrelated files.
Resolve changed files from the immutable pull-request base and head SHAs.
Require only the bounded candidate file to be returned.
Reject an unavailable base SHA and a moved workflow-dispatch target head.
Keep local non-CI repository behavior separate while GitHub Actions --changed mode remains exact and fail-closed.
assertions: GitHub Actions changed-scope resolution never falls back to HEAD~1.
Pull-request event payload base/head identities are used exactly.
Workflow dispatch re-reads the target PR and rejects head movement.
Unavailable base or head commits fail closed.
No repository write, protected-ref mutation, Runtime contact, database access, provider action, deployment, or secret inclusion occurs.

phases.objective: Keep exact changed-scope resolution aligned with future GitHub event and writer-dispatch contracts.
Reject malformed event payloads, missing commits, moved heads, and unsupported events without heuristic fallback.
Repository-only governance validation performs no provider or Runtime canary.
No Production, deployment, Runtime, SQL, migration, database, provider, or external business mutation.
